**Supported:** dek, meta, footer, and sections 0–3 titles/content (section 0 title supported in context of rejected sends, not sleep).

**Nonfactual:** the four section eyebrows.

**Reader-facing prose: fail.** Quote: “Retry filtering makes every delivery exactly once”. Dek, footer, and sections 2–3 hedge correctly; that makes an internal split, not a uniformly false piece.

**Also recorded:** missing wall-clock/measurement limit, zero-budget meaning of `retries`, and `error.retryable`; title attribution of the author’s exactly-once claim; “supplied contract” / “exclusion mechanism” leakage. No code or diagram errors. Unresolved items are label taxonomy only.
